verdict.what_is_wrong: The `ttmem` workload in one container shows sustained cgroup-memory reclaim paired with repeated, very large disk reads, consistent with its memory limit squeezing its working set and slowing the work. No `ttmem` death during reclaim is recorded, so the evidence supports the slowdown/reclaim face of a memory limit, not a demonstrated hard-limit kill; the actual configured limit is not visible in this trace.
